commit.message:
fix(inventory): list the Git panel work's launch sites for what they are

The process inventory was 13 sites short after int/m123 (scan 116,
listed 103). It is 109 of 109 with no launch path changed (lead's go,
2026-10-11 6:05 PM PT, in place of fix/train-spawn-inventory, whose
governed checkout route lands with its third round):

- src/runtime/panel/git/service.ts: the private wrapper `spawn` is
  `runGit` (round 2's diff of that file, the rename only). Seven of the
  thirteen "sites" were that wrapper, not launches.
- the service's import is listed as admitted by the shared git runner:
  admission, the Windows job, then the caller's gate and the spawn in one
  synchronous turn, the gate again at Windows GO.
- src/core/locks/processOwner.ts: a considered exemption; a lock's
  liveness probe must not wait on the governor.
- src/runtime/panel/pullRequests/checkout.ts keeps its two direct
  launches and is listed test-only (`nodeGitProcesses`): nothing in
  production imports the checkout in this release, and the guard proves
  it on every run (references [], exercised true).
- CHANGELOG, Pending: those launches are not yet under the resource
  governor and nothing in this release can start them.
- docs/certification/int0170-combined.md: the table regenerated from
  the inventory, and the record with two drills.

macmini (named, browser-free): spawnInventory, nativeGitService,
nativeGitAdapter, nativeGitSpawn, runtimePullRequestCheckout: 146 passed,
1 skipped; ESLint on the service 0; host typecheck 0. Red drill: a
module-level use of the checkout's factory in conversationGitEntry.ts
fails the inventory test (1 failed, 4 passed); an exported alias nothing
uses does not (the proof follows owners to a use no symbol owns).
Restored byte for byte.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <<email-redacted>>

commit.message:
Merge c/m106-2 (83f8da887, RVCM1062J) into int/train-1011: live argument previews

Round 11 of the branch (final review clean). The Model API backend binds
the selected model's capability record in production: tool rows show an
argument preview in the panel and in ACP on a model whose record verifies
streamed arguments (today `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`). Headless `exec`
keeps its 32,768-token request cap through one resolved cap that the
body, the request schema, the ledger and the start reservation read.

Earlier rounds were held here: c113d3aae refused every real-stack
headless run on its own head (51 cases in execRun and execFetch), found
by running the branch's suites before merging.

Restore after 0.17.1's truth pass (WB-143, 144, 145, 147): the Help row
on vscode:modelApi and acp:modelApi with the lane's summary sentence;
README "Streamed argument previews" without the missing-binding sentence
and with a paragraph naming the one verified model; the progress-list
anchor removed; the loop-guarantees sentence back; a new [Unreleased]
Added entry; roadmap M106 moves previews to the working parts and stays
in progress for Muse Code's native readers. The 0.16.0 entries stay
archived. Held: the packaged README's bullet (WB-146).

Where the lane met the train's code (accepted by the lead):
- ModelApiHost.ts outputCap: the request's resolved record with MINOUT's
  rules; the base's `requested < 1` check is gone as MINOUT removed it;
  memo per record, and both production resolvers build one per resolve.
  The compaction summary floor reads the same record.
- responseAttemptGuard takes the record; M101-1's admission order kept.
- client.ts: MINOUT's minimum refusal, then the confirmed-dispatch
  helper. transport.ts: the admission check directly before
  noteConfirmedRequestStarted. configured.ts: the helper is the only
  confirmed decision; the catch rethrows codec, range and
  stale-confirmation errors.
- execFetch.ts: the run's resolved cap from above, MINOUT's sentence on
  the minimum. en.ts: "Argument Preview" (0.17.1) plus the new
  description key.
- confirmedDispatchInventory.test.ts: three allow-list entries for the
  train's lines that decide no confirmation.
- modelApiLoopGuarantees.test.ts: the cap callback's record also carries
  MINOUT's minimum; MINOUT's last-call assertion takes the record.
- cx1r2Truth, cx1r5Truth: presence where absence was pinned, for
  exactly these items.

Model API pin (lead decision 2026-10-11 15:45 PT): dist/modelApi.js is
532,537 B on this tree against the 530,883 B pin in
deferredBundles.test.ts (train alone 530,683 B). The pin is re-measured
to 532,537 B with its receipt in PLAN.md D6; the 525 KiB cap is
unchanged; it ratchets down when fix/modelapi-diet merges.

Gate:
- own head 83f8da887, linuxlt, three workers, load about 20, `vitest
  related` over the 30 changed sources: 1,136 files, 1,111 passed, 15
  failed, 10 skipped; 44 tests failed, 24,110 passed. Every failing name
  is red on the train too or is a deadline or race under load:
  reviewMaterial 25 and conversationController 4 (the exit-code defect,
  fix/review-git-exit), playbookOutcomes 8 (no husky stubs on rig
  bases), nativeScheduleBackground 1 (fixture fixed on the train),
  vault/peer 1 (private temp folder), usageIntegration 1, usageRollup 3,
  m114ConversationReview 6, accountsPanel.a11y 4, estimator.e2e 1,
  execResources 1 (red on the train in the same hour, 2 of 2),
  spawnBootstrap 1 (alone: branch base 3 of 3 green, merged tree 2 of 3)
  and the setup hooks of runtimeChatGptPackage, visualCapture and
  visualStability.
- merged tree, macbook (named browser-free suites): production build
  exit 0, 155 size rows, none over, split check ok; extension.js
  563,929; modelApi.js 532,537; headless.js 100,078 of 102,400;
  runtimeEngine.js 643,432; providers.js 142,356; modelsPanel.js
  126,355; argument preview chunk 928 B. Activation growth 2,577 of
  3,072. typecheck (5 projects), Prettier and ESLint on changed files,
  deadcode, cycles, duplication: 0.
- merged tree, macbook, both sides' 44 suites: 42 files passed, 3,645
  tests passed, 3 failed: execResources' 5 s case (as above) and execRun
  D29 "4MiB stderr keeps bounded exit" twice, which passes alone 3 of 3
  in 1.1 to 1.4 s.
- red drills on the merged tree (macbook, restored byte for byte): the
  feature back in the in-progress list fails cx1r2Truth and
  featureCatalogDetails; `requested < 1` back fails the two MINOUT cap
  cases. Recorded in docs/certification/m106-capability-binding.md.
- check:plan, roadmap, l10n, reference, host-api, badges pass.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <<email-redacted>>
